hits.title: Exclusive: InKind secures $414M led by Citi for restaurant financing - Fast Company
hits.snippet: Exclusive: InKind lands $414 million led by Citi to dominate how independent restaurants raise money The novel financing platform plans to back 10,000 restaurants over the next year—and has raised more than $1 billion in the past six months to fuel the push. The latest funding comes just one month after InKind secured $320 million from Liberty Mutual Investments and six months after announcing a $450 million round of debt and equity funding led by Magnetar, an Illinois-based investment firm. To InKind founder and CEO Johann Moonesinghe, also a restaurateur, the institutional funding is validation of the company's nontraditional financing bet.
